reason: The image displays characteristics typical of a projectional radiograph (X-ray), such as high contrast between dense bone (white) and air-filled lungs (black), and the superimposition of anatomical structures. MRI scans typically provide cross-sectional views with different tissue contrast mechanisms and do not show cortical bone as bright white in this manner.
